$comment: PHOTO ASSET REGISTRY — every stadium photograph Sift can show, with its provenance. A venue shows a photo ONLY when an asset here is status 'approved' (by the owner); otherwise the designed floodlit fallback.

id names the files: public/stadiums/<id>.webp (desktop), <id>-m.webp (mobile, 3:4 crop of the same photograph), <id>-sm.webp (card strip). Candidates live under curation/stadiums/candidates/ and are never served.
source: where the ORIGINAL came from, its author, licence and original size (and sha256 for owner-supplied originals). transformations: every change made to get from the original to each served file.

crop.focus: desktop object-position (x, y in 0..1). crop.mobile_focus: optional separate framing of the mobile crop. crop.card_focus: card strip anchor. crop.keep: the rectangle of identifying architecture that crops must preserve (normalised source coordinates).

captured.light/sky: the conditions IN the photograph (day / night / indoor; clear / cloud / rain / snow / none). Weather presentation never changes these; it may only pick between approved photos and add a restrained atmosphere layer.
standard: 1 = approved under the PR #9 bar (grandfathered; crops are reported, not enforced). 2 = approved under the stadium phase bar (owner spec 9: every quality-bar item affirmed, crops enforced).
review: audit notes for the owner; not used by the app.

source.file: File:Vegas Kickoff Classic, Brigham Young University (BYU) Cougars 24, University of Arizona Wildcats 16, Allegiant Stadium, Las Vegas, Nevada (52271295939).jpg
source.author: Ken Lund from Reno, Nevada, USA
source.retrieved_note: Licence and author as returned by the Commons API to scripts/stadiums/fetch.mjs on a GitHub runner; not re-verified from the dev container (Commons is unreachable there).

transformations: desktop: convert <original> -auto-orient -strip -resize 2400x1600> -unsharp 0x28+0.32+0.02 -sigmoidal-contrast 3x48% -modulate 100,112,100 -quality 66 -> stadiums/allegiant-stadium.webp

card: convert <original> -auto-orient -strip -resize 720x480^ -gravity center -extent 720x480 -unsharp 0x28+0.32+0.02 -sigmoidal-contrast 3x48% -modulate 100,112,100 -quality 60 -> stadiums/allegiant-stadium-sm.webp
fetched as variant graded-hero2400q66-card720q60 (the Commons thumbnail service at <= 2600 px wide was the input)

mobile: convert stadiums/allegiant-stadium.webp -crop 1200x1600+466+0 +repage -resize 1050x1400> -quality 62 -> stadiums/allegiant-stadium-m.webp (a 3:4 crop of the graded desktop derivative; no further grade)

review.hero: Good: real bowl, roof trusses and light ring, deep field-facing view
review.needs_replacement: No — consider raising desktop focus so the roof reads
review.notes: College game: BYU/Arizona end-zone and midfield paint. At 1280-1920 px the 253 px desktop band shows the far stands only; the roof (the identifier) sits above it.
